source_of_truth: Operator autopilot directive (this conversation, 2026-06-04): 'If a human is leveraging an agentic operator, the dashboard should guide the agent to run the commands and resolve all issues across tabs to automatically clean up install/mapping/etc — interrupting the human only for credentials, spend, destructive changes, or external approval.' Three-tier execution model chosen by the operator: repair plan (emit-only, default) -> repair apply --safe-derived-state (projection/cache regen only) -> repair apply --safe --confirm (explicit allowlist of local safe mutations). Builds on 2026-06-04-005 (render/scope truth), reusing 001 resolution_class + clears_when and 004 freshness.

user_journeys.name: agent-operator-runs-emitted-repair-bundle
user_journeys.description: A human using Codex/Claude/Grok as the operator asks DontPanic for the repair plan for a scope and receives an ordered, dependency-sorted, safety-classified JSON bundle. The agent runs the auto_safe steps itself and stops at the human_required ones, instead of being handed twenty cards with raw commands.
acceptance_signals: `dontpanic repair plan --scope <s> --format=json` emits ordered actions with command, safety_class, clears_when, plain consequence, and scope
The bundle is dependency-ordered (a prerequisite action precedes its dependent)
human_required / blocked_external actions are present but flagged, not auto-runnable

user_journeys.name: one-button-derived-state-repair-clears-stale-cards
user_journeys.description: An operator runs `repair apply --safe-derived-state` (or clicks 'Repair automatically'); DontPanic regenerates derived/projection state (rebuild dashboard state, recompute what-now, refresh capability status, refresh reconcile CHECK, regen architecture if bounded, clear replaceable generated caches, re-export, suppress resolved) and the stale/phantom cards clear, leaving only genuine human decisions.
acceptance_signals: It refuses deploys, credential setup, paid dispatch, role changes, plan-state mutation, project-registry changes, destructive cleanup, and reconcile-baseline writes
Phantom/stale cards clear after the batch; the remaining set is human_required/blocked_external/info
Each executed action is round-trip verified

user_journeys.name: planner-recomputes-after-state-changing-step
user_journeys.description: After a safe step changes state, the planner recomputes the next needed step (a fixpoint loop) rather than running a stale static list; it terminates when only human_required/blocked_external/info remain or no progress is made, and logs whatever it deferred.
acceptance_signals: A step whose output changes the needed next step triggers a re-plan, not a static continuation
The loop terminates at a fixpoint (only human/blocked/info left, or no progress)
Deferred actions are logged with why (safety tier, dependency, or no-progress)

user_journeys.name: unsafe-action-never-auto-runs
user_journeys.description: An action that deploys, sets credentials, dispatches a paid agent, changes roles, mutates plan state or project registry, deletes files destructively, or writes a reconcile baseline is classified human_required (or only confirmed_local behind --safe --confirm with an explicit allowlist) and never auto-runs under --safe-derived-state; it appears as a human card with plain consequence text.
acceptance_signals: None of the forbidden action kinds run under --safe-derived-state
An unclassified action defaults to human_required and never auto-runs (fail closed)
--safe --confirm runs only an explicit allowlist of confirmed_local mutations, each still safety_class + clears_when + round-trip verified

non_goals: No deploys, credential setup, paid agent dispatch, role changes, or destructive file cleanup under any --safe tier
No plan-state or project-registry mutation under --safe-derived-state (derived/cached projection regeneration only)
No reconcile-baseline write without explicit approval (confirmed_local allowlist + --confirm)
No remote / multi-operator execution; no hosted control plane
No new resolution predicates beyond 001/005's closed registry
No re-implementation of the render gate, scope lattice, or freshness (that is 005)
completion_test: `dontpanic repair plan --scope <s> --format=json` emits a dependency-ordered, safety-classified, zero-mutation bundle (command + safety_class + clears_when + plain_consequence + scope). `dontpanic repair apply --safe-derived-state` executes ONLY apply_tier=derived_state actions (projection/cache/recompute), recomputes after each step, round-trip verifies each targeted card cleared/chained/became human_required, re-plans to a fixpoint, and refuses every forbidden kind (deploy/creds/paid/role/plan-state/registry/destructive/baseline). `dontpanic repair apply --safe --confirm` additionally runs only an explicit allowlist of confirmed_local mutations, each still safety_class + clears_when + round-trip verified. Safety is producer-asserted; an unclassified action defaults to human_required and never auto-runs. The dashboard exposes 'Repair automatically' and 'Copy agent repair plan', scope-aware via 005. Full orchestrate sweep stays green.
